capability: Read-only validation of exact owner-private, fixed-path human registry and role-grant subjects after human-supplied attestations and exact independent CLEAN reviews are installed.
acceptance: exact approved role and opaque ID
registry and grants carry human-supplied signature/attestation fields
independence, no-conflict, blind-commitment, and no-map-access attestations
fixed-path independent CLEAN review bound to each exact subject hash and byte length
distinct G1 and G2 humans; distinct G3 when triggered
owner, mode, fixed path, byte length, hash, duplicate-key, and component nofollow checks

g3_policy: G3 subject and review are ignored until the grading-v3 disagreement trigger occurs, then required exactly.
self_mint_policy: The package exposes no writer, signer, reviewer, installer, activation, network, provider, or live-registry pinning surface. Declarations are not cryptographic identity proof and validation still returns not-live/not-countable pending a separate explicit pinning decision.
templates: PENDING_HUMAN_SIGNATURE, activation=false, countable=false for role grants, signature fields absent, and review artifacts absent.
allowed_claim: Disabled provider-free registry/attestation validation kit and pending nonauthorizing templates only; no human has attested and no grader is live.
